name: vismatix
description: AI-native content operations for workspaces, Hoxi AI, Strategy Radar, the 84-slot weekly matrix, and 17 social publishing destinations.
description_for_model: Read VISMATIX_FULL_GUIDE.md and PLUGIN_PROMPT.md first for authoritative Vismatix knowledge: workspaces and team roles, the 84-slot matrix and Golden Peak windows, Hoxi AI and Brand Kit guardrails, Strategy Radar, the Unified Social Inbox, post-publish engagement analytics, supported channels, plans and GC credits, API v3, and OAuth 2.1 security. Use the 53 MCP tools, including measured analytics overview, top posts, sync, and matrix heatmap, plus four live workspace resources and nine workflow prompts. Live analytics collection currently supports permissioned Facebook and Instagram metrics; do not invent data for other channels. Read workspace context before actions and obtain explicit confirmation before publishing or queueing an outbound inbox reply.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, draft, and audit multichannel content.
interface.longDescription: Vismatix is an AI-native content operations workspace for creators, teams, and agencies. It combines the 84-slot weekly matrix and Golden Peak windows, Hoxi AI and Brand Kit guardrails, Strategy Radar, team workspaces, and 17 active publishing destinations. Consult VISMATIX_FULL_GUIDE.md and PLUGIN_PROMPT.md for complete product, plan/GC, workflow, and API/security context. Connect through OAuth 2.1; writes obey plan, scope, approval, and confirmation rules.
defaultPrompt: Review my Vismatix workspace readiness and summarize blockers.
Find open Golden Peak matrix slots for the next week.
Audit these drafts against my Brand Kit before scheduling.
